exposure: Ultrasound-guided tip location for midline catheters
Midline catheter tip placement location (axillary vein vs. subclavian vein vs. axillary-subclavian transition)
cohort: The study included patients receiving midline catheters.
finding: Ultrasound-guided tip location for midline catheters was feasible in 98.9% of patients and was associated with a lower incidence of catheter-related venous thrombosis (2.62%) compared to one historical group without ultrasound guidance (9%), suggesting an ideal tip position in the axillary or subclavian vein.
